source/contoso-portal/README.md.text:
# Contoso Portal

The customer portal of Contoso. Python 3.12.

Run the tests with `pytest -q`.

source/contoso-portal/bugs.md.text:
# Known bugs

1. Search returns no results when the query ends with a space (for example 'router '). Severity: high. Found by Sam Okafor.
2. The date range filter ignores the end date: results stop one day early. Severity: medium. Found by Lena Fischer.
3. Export to CSV drops accented characters in customer names (for example 'Jose' written with an accent). Severity: low. Found by Priya Natarajan.

source/contoso-portal/tools.md.text:
# Tools

## deploy
Deploys the portal. Builds it, puts it in the staging slot, and in production when the production flag is set. Not on Fridays without approval.

## backup
Copies the database to the backup store every night.

source/contoso-portal/docs/architecture..text:
# Architecture

Web front end -> portal service (Python) -> customer database. Search runs in the portal service.

source/contoso-portal/models/contoso-cha.text: Contoso chat model, 7 billion parameters, fine-tuned on support tickets. Weights in model.safetensors.
